paper.use: The ground. Every page, every card, every deck starts here. Not white: paper.

ink.use: All type, the rules, the buttons, the ID card bands. Reads as black without being black.

red.use: The edit. Margin notes, strike-throughs, circles, ticks, the brand's one loud colour.

sheet.use: A sheet laid on the paper: cards, the outbox, the badges.

ink-2.use: Second-rank body text, captions inside cards.

grey.use: Labels, meta lines, struck-out words, anything the eye should pass over.

rule.use: Hairlines and borders. Never for text.

margin.use: The ruled margin line down the page, and the left rule on quoted lines.

hi.use: Text selection and the occasional wash behind a note. Never a fill for large areas.

blue.use: Only for what the visitor writes themselves: their own margin notes, and focus rings on forms.

news.use: The newspaper-concept panel on the Work page.
